title: Report an issue from the CRM

steps.caption: Any CRM page
steps.narration: When something in the CRM doesn't work, you can tell us from the page you are on.

steps.caption: Report an issue
steps.narration: At the bottom of the page, choose Report an issue.

steps.value: Send an estimate to a client
steps.caption: What were you trying to do?
steps.narration: First, say what you were trying to do.

steps.value: I chose Send estimate and the button kept spinning.
steps.caption: What happened instead?
steps.narration: Then say what happened instead: what you clicked, and what you saw.

steps.caption: No passwords
steps.narration: Leave out passwords and card numbers. We never need them.

steps.caption: Which page?
steps.narration: Which page is filled in from where you came from. Change it if the problem is somewhere else.

steps.caption: How bad is it?
steps.narration: Pick how bad it is. A report that says you can't use the site is looked at first.

steps.caption: Screenshot
steps.narration: You can add one screenshot. It's optional.

steps.caption: Report number
steps.narration: You get a report number, and the issue desk reads every report.

steps.caption: Your reports
steps.narration: Your reports shows its status. Our reply appears here too.

steps.caption: Bottom of every page
steps.narration: You'll find Report an issue at the bottom of every CRM page.

youtube.title: How to report an issue from the CRM | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of Report an issue in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will say what you were trying to do and what happened, pick how bad it is, and send the report. Then you will see where its status and our reply appear.
